arxiv-2212-00672.title: A quantum mechanics for magnetic horizons
arxiv-2212-00672.creator: Francesco Benini
arxiv-2212-00672.description: Abstract SISSA 19/2022/FISI We construct an \mathcal{N}=2 supersymmetric gauged quantum mechanics, by starting from the 3d Chern-Simons-matter theory holographically dual to massive Type IIA string theory on AdS {}_{4}\times S^{6} , and Kaluza-Klein reducing on S^{2} with a background that is dual to the asymptotics of static dyonic BPS black holes in AdS 4 .

arxiv-2212-07758.title: Thermal one point functions, large d d and interior geometry of black holes
arxiv-2212-07758.creator: Justin R. David, Srijan Kumar
arxiv-2212-07758.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Justin R. David, Srijan Kumar. We study thermal one point functions of massive scalars in A ​ d ​ S d + 1 AdS_{d+1} black holes. These are induced by coupling the scalar to either the Weyl tensor squared or the Gauss-Bonnet term. Grinberg and Maldacena argued that the one point functions sourced by the Weyl tensor exponentiate in the limit of large scalar masses and they contain information of the black hole geometry behind the horizon.

arxiv-2303-00767.title: A Feasible Hybrid Quantum-Assisted Digital Signature for Arbitrary Message Length
arxiv-2303-00767.creator: Marta Irene García Cid, Laura Ortiz Martín, David Domingo Martín, Rodrigo Martín Sánchez-Ledesma, Juan Pedro Brito Méndez, Vicente Martín Ayuso
arxiv-2303-00767.description: Abstract Currently used digital signatures based on asymmetric cryptography will be vulnerable to quantum computers running Shor’s algorithm. In this work, we propose a new quantum-assisted digital signature protocol based on symmetric keys generated by QKD, that allows signing and verifying messages in a simple way implementing an integration of currently available classical and quantum technologies.

arxiv-2312-16612.title: Exploring intra-task relations to improve meta-learning algorithms

arxiv-2312-16612.description: Abstract 1 Abstract Meta-learning has emerged as an effective methodology to model several real-world tasks and problems due to its extraordinary effectiveness in the low-data regime. arxiv-2402-05652.title: Scattering of surface waves by ocean currents: the U2H map
arxiv-2402-05652.creator: Han Wang 1, Ana B. Villas Bôas 2, Jacques Vanneste 1, William R. Young 3
arxiv-2402-05652.description: Abstract Ocean turbulence at meso- and submesocales affects the propagation of surface waves through refraction and scattering, inducing spatial modulations in significant wave height (SWH). We develop a theoretical framework that relates these modulations to the current that induces them.

arxiv-2504-18600.title: QuantBench: Benchmarking AI Methods for Quantitative Investment
arxiv-2504-18600.creator: Saizhuo Wang, Hao Kong, Jiadong Guo, Fengrui Hua, Yiyan Qi, Wanyun Zhou, Jiahao Zheng, Xinyu Wang, Lionel M. Ni, Jian Guo
arxiv-2504-18600.description: Abstract The field of artificial intelligence (AI) in quantitative investment has seen significant advancements, yet it lacks a standardized benchmark aligned with industry practices. This gap hinders research progress and limits the practical application of academic innovations. We present QuantBench, an industrial-grade benchmark platform designed to address this critical need.

arxiv-2509-11949.title: On the K-point in moduli space
arxiv-2509-11949.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . We study a class of infinite-distance loci, referred to as K-points, in one-parameter complex-structure moduli spaces of type IIB string theory compactified on Calabi-Yau manifolds. We show that around K-points the effective four-dimensional supergravity exhibits certain unusual properties. The two most prominent being that the leading order dependence of the prepotential on the gauge couplings is non-perturbative and that the leading gauge kinetic terms in the action vanish when evaluated on an anti self-dual graviphoton background.

pmc-12736909.title: The Updated Assessment of the Liverwort Flora of Laos, the Least-Studied Higher Plants Group in Indochina
pmc-12736909.creator: Vadim A. Bakalin, Seung Se Choi, In Chun Hwang, Myung-Ok Moon, Ksenia G. Klimova
pmc-12736909.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The previously published liverwort checklist of Laos, one of the least-studied countries in Asia, was titled “Listing the Unknown”, based on the fact that only 66 species are known for such a landscape-diverse country. Our collection revealed 39 genera and 76 species, 62 of which are newly recorded species to the country, bringing the total number of known species to 128.

In this article, the detection properties of the monolithic planar ceramic scintillation elements are reported for the first time.
